reviews.author: Sabiha Shahid
reviews.text: The ramen was really tasty. I had the beef steak ramen and it was spot on. The main problem was the server with pink hair wearing glasses it was me and my husband. The restaurant wasn’t busy either but when I finished my meal she was literally rushing us to get the bill. When we said she can bring the bill on table and asked whether it’s gonna be cash or card we said to give a couple of minutes but she came back 2 times 2 to ask whether we are ready to pay or not which seemed like she was trying to kick us out of the place. People are paying £15 to £20 for having a bowl of ramen but getting this type of horrible service is disgusting.

reviews.text: My partner and I were in need of some comfort food after a long day's travel and Maki & Ramen's was just the thing! The atmosphere was lovely, the staff were very quick and attentive plus the food was great! I had the salmon sushi platter which was brill and my partner loved his Steak Ramen! Presentation was great and the flavour (particularly with the ramen) was great too. Brilliant option as an inexpensive Japanese food option!

reviews.author: Lux Alexander King
reviews.text: I went for the first time yesterday and had an incredible time- I'm an electric wheelchair user, and from the moment I went in the staff were incredibly attentive and accomodating. They seated us in a place where my chair could fit and wouldn't be blocking anyone from getting past, and when they realised the table was a bit low for me, they went and got wooden platters to stack under the table to raise the height. Despite being short-staffed, the whole evening Quinn and Hannah made sure I was comfortable, and when I let them know I have coeliac disease, they came out with a gluten-free menu right away and replaced the soy sauce with a gluten-free version without needing to ask. I had the salmon avocado sushi, and it was so good- you could smell the mirin when it came out, and the fish was so fresh. Definitely the best salmon sushi roll I've had. Despite my friend and I staying until closing time, the staff were super kind and Quinn checked some of the gluten-free dessert options for me since I'd forgotten to check the menu earlier. The staff with the black hair and beard was also very helpful, and made sure the table was fixed when he realised it had started to wobble. Incredible first experience here, and I'd be delighted to come back again. My only complaint was that the music was a little loud, but nothing unbearable. Thank you!! ♡

reviews.author: Fiona Yu
reviews.text: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (1/5) Very disappointing experience. We came back because our first visit was good, but the quality has dropped dramatically. The so-called soft-boiled ramen egg was completely hard-boiled with no runny yolk at all. The pork katsu was badly overcooked and black on the outside, making it dry, unpleasant and impossible to eat. Even more disappointing, the "Japanese " tonkotsu served with the ramen was just small pieces of shredded pork, not proper slices of tonkotsu as you would expect from a Japanese restaurant. This was nowhere near the standard a restaurant serving Japanese food should offer. The food quality was extremely poor and nothing like our previous visit 9 months ago. The only positive was that the staff were friendly and helpful. The ramen were remade and they apologized for the batch of fully boiled eggs (yet they still served them to customers) with a slightly discounted price. Unfortunately good service could not make up for the very disappointing food. The chef should genuinely understands and delivers the authenticity of the food they are selling. Sadly, we won't be returning unless the food quality improves significantly.

reviews.text: Sadly very disappointing. Especially considering the reviews they have. Which drew me in to prebook. This wasn't a walk in and we didn't know better. And wow... the food was really poor. Expected the food to be much better. Table service was excellent. Two staff looked after us and both were spot on and super friendly. The later staff member even removing an item from the bill as it was inedible. Food was not great. Looked insipid on arrival. No taste or real texture. Rushed and bland. Did not look anything like recent photos posted by other customers. Our table was sticky around the sides. Toilets needed a clean and the floor a mop (rather sticky) and the kitchen floors did not look clean either. Leave you doors open and public will look in. It just was sad that somewhere that had potential and such a 'bigged up website' of how they came to be and the owners philosophy fell very flat. Bad experience maybe on a bad day. 3 Nice beers for 80 quid. Real shame but wouldn't consider M&R again sadly...

reviews.author: N A
reviews.text: Visited and decided we were going to sit outside. All the staff were inside huddled together in a corner chatting and didn't even notice I was standing by the door waiting for someone to hand me a menu and ask whether they accepted cash. It actually took one of the chefs to notice me and tell them there was a customer waiting. I honestly didn't even realise they were the staff because the atmosphere made it seem like they were just a group of friends sitting around laughing and talking together. Very unprofessional. I was told cash was accepted, but when the same staff member came to take our order, she said that because we were sitting outside we'd have to scan the QR code on the table and pay by card. I reminded her that I'd already said we'd be paying cash, which really should have been explained from the beginning. She then said she could take our order, but we'd have to pay straight after ordering, which was absolutely fine. However, when she told me the total, it was higher than what I'd worked out from the menu prices. She hadn't mentioned that a service charge had been added, and I had to ask twice before she explained what the extra charge was. Considering the service we'd already received, I asked for the service charge to be removed. From that point on, her attitude noticeably changed and the customer service became even worse. When we finished eating, I thanked her and got no response at all. The food itself tasted good, but for the price, the portion sizes were very small and definitely need improving. Overall, a very disappointing experience. The lack of professionalism, poor communication and unfriendly service completely overshadowed the food. Unfortunately, I won't be returning.

reviews.author: T M
reviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10/10 – Outstanding Experience at Maki Ramen Old Street! I left Maki Ramen on Old Street completely full, so satisfied, and so thoroughly impressed by the incredible flavours! As a solo diner, going out alone can sometimes feel intimidating, but the team here made me feel so comfortable, welcomed, and confident from the moment I walked in. I honestly wouldn't have had such a fantastic dining experience if it weren't for them. A huge, heartfelt thank you to the whole team: Hajora for the warm welcome and setting such a wonderful vibe right away. Navin for making sure everything was running seamlessly. Maria for her attentive care and fantastic energy. Amidu for the efficient and friendly service throughout the meal. Jannat for going the extra mile with those thoughtful touches that make a huge difference. If you’re looking for rich, comforting, flavour-packed ramen and top-tier hospitality—especially if you're dining solo—Maki Ramen Old Street is an absolute must-visit. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Seli
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this new ramen spot! Everything we ordered was delicious. The Steak Tataki was a great starter, the Three Kinds Sashimi was incredibly fresh with generous, thick slices, and the Seafood Hell Ramen had a rich broth with a proper spicy kick. The sides were just as impressive. The Dynamic Prawn with its refreshing yuzu flavour was amazing, and the Pumpkin Croquettes were crispy on the outside and soft inside. The cocktails were also excellent—it’s exactly the kind of place where you can enjoy both great food and drinks. A special thank you to Navin for the fantastic service. Everyone on the team was warm, attentive and welcoming. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Phyllis
reviews.text: The food was great but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing. We ordered the lunch deal yet we were still overcharged. When checking the bill we were told that the drinks we chose were “premium drinks” with a £2 surcharge each and therefore not included in the lunch deal. Even though the staff member who served us had clearly confirmed that those drinks were not listed as premium on the lunch deal menu. As we were in a rush to leave she offered to remove the service charge, but somehow we still ended up paying the extra drink charges anyway (not sure what’s happened here..) On top of that, we tried to order the chicken karaage and the bone broth ramen but were told that neither was available… which was surprising for a ramen restaurant. Also, when we asked for takeaway containers we were given paper bowls and told that the soup would likely spill if we used them..?

reviews.author: みっか
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) Maki Nori was absolutely delicious! The medium fatty tuna hand roll was especially superb. Every dish had an authentic Japanese flavor that reminded me of Japan. The sushi chefs were highly skilled and had extensive knowledge of the origins of the ingredients and sushi in general, allowing me to enjoy truly authentic sushi. It was fantastic to be able to eat such delicious sushi even overseas. I definitely want to go back to this restaurant! (Original) Maki Nori、とても美味しかったです！特に中とろ手巻きが絶品でした。どの料理も本格的な日本の味で、日本を思い出しました。寿司職人の方々もとても技術が高く、ネタの産地やお寿司に関する知識も豊富で、本格的なお寿司を楽しむことができました。海外でもおいしいお寿司が食べれて最高でした。ぜひまた行きたいお店です！

reviews.author: Nahshon
reviews.text: Quite a nice restaurant with a very pristine and bright lighting. It is much more expensive than your typical sushi restaurant and portion sizes are on the smaller side. We really loved the scallop crudo, sea bream crudo, akemi crudo. The sauce accompanying it was superb and well conceived, and it definitely is our most favorite. We also got the 15 pcs Chef’s selection, black dragon roll, green dragon roll, soft shell crab roll, spicy tuna roll. Soft shell crab roll and black dragon roll were definitely our favourites.
